inputs.message: What are the quiet hours and the penalty for violating them?

chunks.text: Quiet hours are from 10pm to 7am every day, including weekends.
The penalty for violating quiet hours is a 50 dollar fine per reported incident.

outputs.reference_answer: Quiet hours run 10pm to 7am daily, and violating them carries a $50 fine per incident.

inputs.message: Can I keep a large dog and does it need board approval?

chunks.text: Pets are allowed and must be registered with building management within 30 days.
A large dog over 25 kilograms needs written board approval before moving in.

outputs.reference_answer: Yes, pets are allowed and must be registered; a large dog over 25kg also needs written board approval.

inputs.message: How do I reserve the rooftop terrace and what is the booking fee?

chunks.text: Reserve the rooftop terrace through the resident portal at least 7 days in advance.
The rooftop terrace booking fee is 75 dollars per event plus a refundable deposit.

outputs.reference_answer: Reserve the rooftop terrace via the resident portal 7+ days ahead; the fee is $75 per event plus a refundable deposit.

inputs.message: When is trash collected and where do I leave recycling bins?

chunks.text: Trash is collected every Tuesday and Friday morning before 8am.
Recycling bins are left in the blue-marked area of the ground-floor service room.

outputs.reference_answer: Trash is collected Tuesday and Friday before 8am; recycling bins go in the blue-marked ground-floor service room.

inputs.message: What is the guest parking policy and the overnight limit?

chunks.text: Guest parking is available in spaces marked G on level P1 with a visitor pass.
Overnight guest parking is limited to 3 consecutive nights per month.

outputs.reference_answer: Guests park in the G spaces on P1 with a visitor pass, limited to 3 consecutive overnight stays per month.

inputs.message: How do I report a maintenance emergency after hours?

chunks.text: Report a maintenance emergency after hours by calling the 24-hour emergency line.
After-hours emergencies include flooding, no heat in winter, and gas smells.

outputs.reference_answer: Call the 24-hour emergency line for after-hours emergencies such as flooding, no heat, or gas smells.

inputs.message: What are the gym hours and is a key fob required for access?

chunks.text: The fitness gym is open daily from 5am to 11pm.
Gym access requires a registered key fob tied to your unit.

outputs.reference_answer: The gym is open 5am-11pm daily and requires a registered key fob for access.

inputs.message: How much notice must I give before moving out and what is the cleaning requirement?

chunks.text: Provide 60 days written notice before moving out of the unit.
The unit must be professionally cleaned before the final move-out inspection.

outputs.reference_answer: Give 60 days written notice and have the unit professionally cleaned before the final move-out inspection.

inputs.message: Are short-term sublets allowed and what is the minimum lease term?

chunks.text: Short-term sublets under 30 days are not allowed in the building.
The minimum lease term for any sublet is 6 months with board notification.

outputs.reference_answer: Short-term sublets under 30 days are banned; the minimum sublet term is 6 months with board notification.

inputs.message: Where do I pick up packages and how long are they held?

chunks.text: Packages are picked up from the parcel room next to the lobby concierge desk.
Packages are held for 10 days before being returned to sender.

outputs.reference_answer: Pick up packages from the parcel room by the lobby concierge; they are held for 10 days before return.
